headline: Record assets and disciplined execution drive strong quarter
summary_short: Ameriprise reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $5.01 billion, up 11.6% y/y, with GAAP diluted EPS of $11.98 (+11.7% y/y) and adjusted operating EPS of $11.07 (+22% y/y), as total client assets under management, administration and advisement grew to a record $1.8 trillion.
summary_long: Revenue growth was led by Advice & Wealth Management, where adjusted operating net revenues rose 16% y/y to $3.2 billion on 15% client-asset growth and strong wrap net inflows. Asset Management pretax adjusted operating earnings rose 23% to $274 million as net pretax margin expanded 370bp to 42.7%, helped by strong Seligman performance, even as the segment posted net outflows of $6.5 billion (improved 26% y/y). GAAP net income growth (+5% y/y) trailed adjusted operating growth (+14% y/y) on less favorable derivative and market-risk-benefit valuation impacts versus the year-ago quarter. The company returned $932 million to shareholders (91% of operating earnings): $774 million buybacks, $158 million dividends. Full-year 2026 operating effective tax rate is guided to 20-22%.

drivers.explanation: Growth was driven by Advice & Wealth Management (adjusted net revenues +16% y/y on 15% client-asset growth and strong wrap net inflows) and Asset Management (+14% y/y on asset growth including strong Seligman technology-strategy performance).
GAAP net income grew slower than adjusted operating earnings because the year-ago quarter had more favorable market impacts on derivative and market-risk-benefit valuations than the current quarter.

Management attributes the quarter's strength to continued asset growth, disciplined expense management, and a record $1.8 trillion in total client assets under management, administration and advisement.
